notes: disabled: skills kept in the catalog and collection but not installed; sync/prune-optional.py moves them to ~/.config/opencode/skills-disabled/.
removed: skills deleted from the repository and the collection; the tombstone stops a machine snapshot from adding them back.
Remove a name from disabled, run sync-skills.ps1, and the skill is installed again.
